newsitem.title: CHINA: Zurich Insurance to help China insurer.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Insurance to help China insurer.

text.p: Zurich Reinsurance Centre Co of Switzerland has signed a cooperation agreement with Xin Hua (New China) Life Insurance Co Ltd, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
The agreements calls for the two insurers to cooperate in personnel training, technology and after-sales service, the news agency said.
Xin Hua Insurance has collected 580 million yuan ($69.9 million) in life insurance premiums since its establishment last August, company assistant general manager Sun Weiguang said.
The insurer plans to establish about six branches in major Chinese cities this year, the news agency said without giving further details.
